name: One Million Kisses
source:
There was a time when five sisters, the Seasons, ruled over the weather from their mountain. Their names were Spring, Rain, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. 

[from [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
曾经有一个时代，Seasons五姐妹从山上掌管着天气。她们分别名为春、雨、夏、秋与冬。

[摘自[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
